## The Evolution of Baseball Analytics {.center}

## About Our Presenter 

- [Tyler Burch](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tylerjburch/) is a Lead Data Analyst in baseball research and development with the Boston Red Sox, where he works on the Player Evaluation team after several years in Baseball Sciences.

- Before joining the Red Sox, he was a postdoctoral researcher at Argonne National Laboratory, developing simulation and machine learning methods for particle physics on Aurora, the first U.S. exascale computer.

- He earned his Ph.D. working on the ATLAS experiment at CERN, with research focused on rare Higgs boson interactions, machine learning for particle classification, and software for high-performance detector systems. Outside of work, Tyler enjoys jazz, baking bread, and running.
